attempts.summary: Created the appworker account on node1 and set its login-session limits to 8192 open files and 256 processes via /etc/security/limits.d/90-appworker.conf. Verified live in a real login shell (sudo -u appworker -i). Performed the mandatory single-node restart: captured a healthy baseline (boot_id, account, limits config), restarted node1 with `shutdown -r now`, polled until reconnected, confirmed boot_id changed, and re-verified the account and enforced limits (8192/256) persisted post-reboot.
